questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Student housing facilities for a select group.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: It is nice living on campus and economically possibly the best solution. You must be prepared to take resonspibility of the appartement and communicate with your room mates concerning the expected level of cleanliness, social rules etc.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was very old and many things were broken, it was not clean when we moved in, very little privacy. Good location and nice views.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Not very easy, I ended up being too late in the process and got the residual courses available.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was difficult to find, no reminders about course selection.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be aware of the course registration in good time and hurry up applying.

questions.answer: More casual, not as tangible as that of UCPH.
